answer_1.quote: Large language models (LLMs) excel in complex natural language processing (NLP) tasks due to extensive pre-training on large corpora embedding prior knowledge in their parameters. Based on the prior knowledge, LLMs can achieve semantic understanding, perform reasoning, and generate reasonable responses in diverse question-answering tasks.
answer_1.outputs: natural language answers to complex questions over knowledge graphs
